claims.text: Raymond James offers multiple affiliation options, which it refers to as AdvisorChoice®, under which financial advisors affiliate directly as either employees or independent contractors, or as employees of third-party RIAs and broker-dealers serviced through its RIA and Custody Services division, per the FY2025 10-K.
AdvisorChoice® is described as a platform of dynamic options and the freedom to choose among them, letting advisors match their professional goals to the affiliation option that is right for them.
The affiliation options listed by Raymond James include Traditional Employee, Advisor Select, Independent Contractor, Bank & Credit Union, and Corporate RIA.

Employee financial advisors work in a traditional branch supported by local management and administrative staff, serve predominantly retail clients, and are compensated primarily through a payout on revenues they generate, also participating in the firm's employee benefit plans.

Independent contractor financial advisors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and, accordingly, receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors.

On the earnings call for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, management stated independent payouts are higher than employee payouts because independent advisors cover their own overhead, real estate, and health insurance, while the employee side uses tiered payout systems where higher production moves an advisor up the payout grid.

Independent contractor financial advisors may affiliate directly or through an affiliated bank or credit union in the Financial Institutions Division, and with specific approval may conduct certain other approved business activities such as insurance products, independent RIA services, and accounting and tax services.

On the earnings call for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, management stated it is agnostic about how an advisor affiliates—employee, independent contractor, or RIA custody—wanting advisors to choose based on fit with its culture, values, platform, and capabilities.

In its 2025 investor day deck, Raymond James described the affiliation spectrum as ranging from employee (RJA) to independent contractor (ICD) to RIA & Custody Services, noting the movement to independence is not channel-specific.
Under the Traditional Employee model, advisors receive up to a 50% payout plus the full array of competitive employee benefits offerings.
Under the Advisor Select model, advisors receive a 70-80% gross payout plus the full array of competitive employee benefits offerings, and run their own branch.
Under the Independent Contractor model, advisors receive an 81% to 90% payout and leverage third-party partnerships to build their own benefits package.
Under the Bank & Credit Union model, advisors receive a competitive compensation package from the financial institution in partnership with Raymond James.
Under the Corporate RIA model, advisors receive an 81% to 90% payout and build their own benefits package through third-party partnerships.
Under the RIA & Custody Services model, advisors work with their RIA or broker/dealer to determine compensation and create their own benefits package.
